housing: Most New Yorkers rent, mostly in prewar walk-ups, elevator buildings and floors of row houses; a large share of apartments are rent stabilized.

tenantHelp.name: NYC Mayor's Office to Protect Tenants
tenantHelp.what: city office with tenant rights information and help

climate: Turn on the heat and hot water and photograph radiators and window seals; winters are cold and landlords must provide heat during the heat season.
fact: Many New York apartments are rent stabilized, so it is worth asking the landlord or checking with the state whether yours is covered before you sign.
